# F10: the game's own scripts {#sec-fg-game-scripts}

The game ships its own script library. The library holds the engine helper
functions and the editor modules. This page states the library that works, the
form that does not work, the engine limits, and the visible defect a script
fault shows. Read the shipped library first, then call its functions by name.

## What works

- The `functions_f.pbo` library holds 2308 files. The tree holds 1139 `.sqf`
  files and 1105 `.sqfc` files. The rest are the shared includes and the
  `config.bin` {src:pbo:Addons/functions_f.pbo}.
- A function ships as a pair. A readable `.sqf` file sits next to the compiled
  `.sqfc` file of the same name. The example is `Waypoints/fn_wpSuppress.sqf`
  and `Waypoints/fn_wpSuppress.sqfc` {src:script:docs/engine/engine-pbo-inventory.md}.
- The readable `.sqf` file is the primary source for the engine script
  behaviour. The first line of `fn_wpSuppress.sqf` declares its arguments:
  `private ["_group","_pos","_target","_wp"];`.
  {src:script:addons/vision/functions/vision/fnc_calculateViewDistance.sqf}
- The library registers every function in `CfgFunctions`. The registration
  names the function, its category and its file. The engine calls a registered
  function by that name {src:script:docs/engine/engine-pbo-inventory.md}.
- The engine naming convention is `BIS_fnc_<name>`. AEE calls 20 of these
  functions. `fnc_triggerLightning.sqf` calls `BIS_fnc_lightning` when the
  function is present {src:script:addons/weatherfx/functions/weather/fnc_triggerLightning.sqf}.
- The `modules_f.pbo` library holds 221 entries. It carries the Eden editor
  modules and the Zeus curator modules. Each module is a `CfgVehicles` class
  with a `CfgFunctions` file {src:pbo:Addons/modules_f.pbo}.
- A module calls its function at run time. The curator module
  `ModulePostprocess_F` calls `BIS_fnc_modulePostprocess`. That function reads
  the named template and applies it to the camera.
  {src:script:docs/wiki/research/post-process-template-reference.md}

## What does not work

- Reading a `.sqfc` file as text. The engine compiles the file, so the bytes
  are not source. The first bytes of `fn_wpSuppress.sqfc` are binary.
  {src:pbo:Addons/functions_f.pbo}.
- A call to a function that is not compiled on every build. AEE notes that
  `BIS_fnc_min` is not compiled on all headless builds, so
  `fnc_calculateViewDistance.sqf` writes the comparison chain by hand.
  {src:script:addons/vision/functions/vision/fnc_calculateViewDistance.sqf}
- A written assumption about an internal helper name. An internal function is
  not part of the public surface. A later game version can rename it, and the
  call then fails at load {src:script:docs/engine/engine-pbo-inventory.md}.

## Limitations

- A `.sqfc` file needs its matching `.sqf` file to read. The pair shares one
  name. A missing `.sqf` file leaves the compiled file alone and unreadable
  {src:pbo:Addons/functions_f.pbo}.
- The function library is versioned with the game. The shipped library carries
  a version and a product tag, so a call matches one game build.
  {src:script:docs/engine/engine-pbo-inventory.md}.
- The library carries no shipped `.sqf` source in the mod. AEE reads the pair
  and calls the function by its registered name.
  {src:script:tools/sqf_validator.py}.

## Breaks visually

- A script fault at load. A script error stops the function at its first bad
  line. The visible result is a missing effect or a frozen state. The source
  contract test locks one such class, a nil read before the guard.
  {src:script:tools/tests/test_sqf_nil_reads.py}
- A module that runs before its dependency. The module calls its function
  before the library registers it. The call does nothing and the module
  appears dead {src:script:docs/wiki/research/post-process-template-reference.md}.
- A renamed internal helper. The call fails at load and the effect never
  reaches the frame {src:script:addons/vision/functions/vision/fnc_calculateViewDistance.sqf}.
